external_requirements: The bundled fixture exercises deterministic rules and balance accounting only; engine builds and subjective fun require adapters and human evidence.
input_contract: Versioned game state, rules, code, content, target platforms, replays, player slices, and release policy.
output_contract: Builds, replay hashes, regressions, balance and performance evidence, human playtest evidence, and rollback plan.
problem: Build reproducibly, replay state transitions, run automated and human playtests, audit balance and accessibility, and gate release.
title: Game rules and content to a release decision
